details:
I was thinking that it shouldn't be impossible to enable a face tracking on a PC if it has an integrated camera or some wired webcam on the monitor. I know that in general cameras for computers are worse in tracking faces than smartphone cameras but I think it could be done at least as a test?

I also thought that if the webcamera sees the desktop player's hands it could potentially provide some sort of simple limited hand/gesture tracking? For example, the player could "ask" camera to record their hands on the keyboard or mouse and order it not to react unless hands are lifted above a certain level. For example, hands lie on the table - no reaction, hands are close to the center or below the players chin - the avatar suddenly lifts its hands to a position the player is holding them.

Alternatively, hand tracking could be limited to just imitating hand gestures, perhaps with the round percentage slider that would define how high the avatar should lift its hands in front of them to show a sign if the webcam detects that the player's hands are lifted and making some specific gestures.
title: Face, hand and/or gesture tracking on PC via webcam?
